credits.title: Wolf Creek: Legacy
credits.overview: A family of American tourists wander innocently into Taylor's hunting grounds. When the parents sacrifice themselves to save their children, the kids find themselves alone, lost and hunted in the vast Australian wilderness.

credits.title: War Machine
credits.overview: On one last grueling mission during Army Ranger training, a combat engineer must lead his unit in a fight against a giant otherworldly killing machine.

credits.title: Maggie May
credits.overview: Two estranged sisters, Sam and Maggie, attempt to reconnect after the death of their mother. But Maggie isn't interested in anything, and that could be Sam's worst nightmare.

credits.title: John Doe: Vigilante
credits.overview: When John Doe is convicted of being a vigilante serial killer, a vigilante group named 'Speak for the Dead' emerges in support of John's cause—elevating the debate about justice versus vengeance.

credits.title: Coping
credits.overview: Sometimes it takes a tragedy to change a person.

credits.title: We've All Been There
credits.overview: Jess has to come up with $800 or lose her house. A flat tyre leaves Joan stranded in the middle of nowhere. Matt needs a job. All these stories are brought together as what goes around comes around and they impact each other in a way they couldn't imagine.

credits.title: Crawlspace
credits.overview: A group of elite soldiers sent to infiltrate and extract the lead science team from Pine Gap, Australia's top secret underground military compound, after it comes under attack from unknown forces. credits.title: Underbelly Files: Tell Them Lucifer Was Here
credits.overview: Tell Them Lucifer Was Here depicts the tragic murders of Victorian police officers, Gary Silk and Rod Miller which occurred in 1998 and shows the enormous efforts of the Lorimer Task Force in leading the manhunt for their killer or killers.

credits.title: Under a Red Moon
credits.overview: A family in crisis is drawn into a night of intrigue under the influence of a blood moon.
